digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 22 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, Rust, TypeScript）和 13 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: mattpocock/skills
repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.summary_zh: 来自一线工程师 .agents 目录的 AI 编码 Agent 实战技能集，让 Agent 按真实工程规范干活

repos.name: anthropics/skills
repos.description: Public repository for Agent Skills
repos.summary_zh: Anthropic 官方开源的 Agent 技能库，为 AI 智能体提供可复用的模块化能力扩展

repos.name: harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo
repos.description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
repos.summary_zh: 输入主题或关键词即可用 AI 自动化工作流一键生成高清短视频

repos.name: openai/codex
repos.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
repos.summary_zh: OpenAI 官方出品的终端轻量级编码 Agent，用 Rust 打造，直接在命令行里帮你写代码

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: D4Vinci/Scrapling
repos.description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EM
repos.summary_zh: 一站式 Python 网页抓取框架，从单次请求到大规模爬取全覆盖

repos.name: tw93/Pake
repos.description: Turn any website into a lightweight desktop app with one command, on macOS, Windows and Linux.
repos.summary_zh: 一条命令把任意网站打包成轻量桌面应用，跨 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 三平台

repos.name: Zleap-AI/SAG-Wiki
repos.description: A lightweight knowledge base for people and agents, with ultra fast indexing and most precise retrieval.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的超轻量知识库，索引极快、检索极准，同时服务人和 AI Agent 的 RAG 场景

repos.name: kividbio/kividb
repos.description: A fast, multi-threaded Redis® and Valkey alternative written in Rust: drop-in compatible, with full-text and vector search built in
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的多线程 Redis/Valkey 替代品，兼容现有客户端并内置全文与向量检索

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: ranxianglei/billion-context
repos.description: A context-compression plugin for month-long single sessions (billions of tokens) and small context windows (a 100K context is enough), billion-context
repos.summary_zh: 让单次会话撑到数十亿 Token 的上下文压缩插件，百K窗口也能跑月级长会话

repos.name: shanselman/gputaskman
repos.description: A GPU task manager for Windows, Linux, and WSL: per-process VRAM, GPU activity, and LLM model/KV-cache insights (Windows AMD and NVIDIA).
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台GPU任务管理器，可实时查看每进程显存与GPU活动，并洞察LLM模型及KV缓存占用

repos.name: RunanywhereAI/trnrt
repos.description: The open LLM inference engine for AWS Trainium: NKI megakernels, 1M-token context, OpenAI-compatible API. By RunAnywhere.
repos.summary_zh: 专为 AWS Trainium 打造的开源 LLM 推理引擎，用 NKI 巨型内核支持百万级上下文并兼容 OpenAI API

repos.name: wici-ai/inferssd
repos.description: Run models larger than your RAM or VRAM by streaming MoE experts from SSD. Built on llama.cpp.
repos.summary_zh: 让超出内存或显存的大模型通过从SSD流式加载MoE专家来运行，基于llama.cpp实现

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: ninetyhe-90/training-explore
repos.description: Interactive explorer for learning how large language models are trained
repos.summary_zh: 用交互式可视化拆解大语言模型训练全流程，让抽象的训练原理变得可动手探索

repos.name: FrontiersMindAI/decisionformer
repos.description: Transformers for decision models: fine-tune, load and serve calibrated decsion-model on any Hugging Face model.
repos.summary_zh: 让任意 Hugging Face 模型一键微调、加载并部署为校准决策模型，把 Transformer 直接变成可靠决策器

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: rustdesk/rustdesk
repos.description: An open-source remote desktop application designed for self-hosting, as an alternative to TeamViewer.
repos.summary_zh: 开源远程桌面工具，可自托管替代 TeamViewer，用 Rust 编写兼顾性能与安全

repos.name: anthropics/claude-quickstarts
repos.description: A collection of projects designed to help developers quickly get started with building deployable applications using the Claude API
repos.summary_zh: Anthropic 官方 Claude API 快速上手项目集，提供可直接部署的示例应用帮开发者跳过踩坑快速落地

repos.name: longbridge/gpui-kit
repos.description: Rust GUI components for building fantastic cross-platform desktop application by using GPUI.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 GPUI 的 Rust 跨平台桌面 GUI 组件库，让开发者用高性能原生渲染快速搭建精美桌面应用

repos.name: homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp
repos.description: Configure and automate Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants.
repos.summary_zh: 让 Claude、ChatGPT 等 AI 助手直接配置和自动化 Home Assistant 的 MCP 桥接工具

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: immich-app/immich
repos.description: High performance self-hosted photo and video management solution.
repos.summary_zh: 高性能自托管照片视频管理方案，替代云相册实现数据自主可控与AI智能检索

repos.name: sherlock-project/sherlock
repos.description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks
repos.summary_zh: 输入用户名即可跨社交网络批量追踪账号，11万星标的情报搜集利器

repos.name: ruvnet/RuView
repos.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel
repos.summary_zh: 用普通WiFi信号实现实时空间感知、生命体征监测与存在检测，无需任何摄像头画面

repos.name: zed-industries/zed
repos.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
repos.summary_zh: 由 Atom 与 Tree-sitter 作者打造的高性能多人协作代码编辑器，用 Rust 实现，让编码快如思考

papers.title: Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1,000x Faster than Looped Models

papers.summary_zh: 提出用经典能量下降替代循环模型进行推理，在简单谜题上训练更稳定且推理速度快1000倍

papers.title: FLEX-LBP: Learning Local Binary Patterns with Exact Binary Inference for Texture Classification

papers.abstract: Institutional portfolios operate under investment policy statements that specify asset allocation constraints, often conditioned on market regime information. Deep reinforcement learning has been show

papers.title: Sketching Language Models for Context Attribution
